scope: The authors' current gated Hugging Face release ucf-crcv/BBQ-V at one pinned revision, prepared with the native remote_columnar adapter under the researcher's own accepted terms. Not a claim about the historical SBBench population of the citing paper.

source.gate: auto approval, accepted by the researcher on their own account

footers_and_annotation_columns.what: 45 Parquet footers and the annotation columns

preview_row_groups_with_images.what: the 40 fixed row groups holding the 100 preview rows, image columns included

bytes_transferred.note: Preparation transfer from the worker receipt. The later live reads through the media route (one row group each) are separate and not counted here.

schema.note: Names quoted from the author's shard metadata. The test group has no answer or label columns.

index.method: every page of 1,000 through the live complete-scope query route

sampling.grouping: row group, then row within group
sampling.design: Two-stage cluster sample: 40 of 569 row groups chosen with equal probability, then up to 3 rows within each; clustered by row group, so it is not a prevalence estimate and rows of one group are neighbours in source order. The transfer budget gates admission only and never changes which rows are chosen.
sampling.draw_rule: Row groups ranked by SHA-256("<seed>:row_group:<source name>:<group>") and the lowest are kept; rows of each kept group ranked by SHA-256("<seed>:row:<source name>:<group>:<row>") and the lowest are kept; the best-ranked groups take one extra row when the row count does not divide evenly.
sampling.population: Every row of the 45 Parquet shards of the gated Hugging Face dataset ucf-crcv/BBQ-V at revision a1c78b8f73bc40408993414e3d94714a6a9169d3 (12.45 GB; the card states CC BY-NC 4.0), grouped by file-name prefix: real (14,578 rows; answer options and a native label), synthetic (6,526), test (14,578; no answer columns, and the only configuration the dataset card declares) and test2 (18,732). The card says 14,144 image-question pairs; no group has that count, and the card describes only the test group. The groups overlap: upstream ids are unique inside each group but all ids of the test group also occur in the real group, so a row is identified by its shard and row, never by the upstream id alone. This is the authors' current release, not a claim that the historical SBBench population cited by the paper is any of these groups. Class codes keep the author ClassLabel integers; their names are quoted from the shard metadata. Images stay in the remote shards and are read on request through ETag-bound HTTPS ranges; only the 100 preview originals are kept locally.
sampling.selection_note: Fixed seeded two-stage selection over the complete footer population (row group, then row within group); the transfer budget never changes it. The complete annotation index is independent of this preview.

original_media.method: each of the 100 preview originals fetched through the live media route, decoded, and its SHA-256 compared with the pack

beyond_row_100.note: Each original came from its remote shard by ETag-bound ranges through ?representation=original and decoded. Without that parameter the route serves a lossy AVIF browsing derivative for non-preview images, as the storage policy specifies.

limits: The 100-record preview is a seeded two-stage cluster sample (row group, then row), not a prevalence estimate.
Image bytes beyond the preview and the checked reads were not opened; media_scope stays on_demand_unverified.
No shard SHA-256 was computed locally; reads are bound to the strong ETag and the Hub LFS digest recorded in the recipe.
Identity of the paper's SBBench population with any of the four file groups is not established.
Publication rights: CC BY-NC 4.0 stated, source web-photo rights unreviewed; nothing is approved for publication.
